title: Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship Programme
description: Hungary's flagship international scholarship, based on bilateral agreements, funding bachelor's, one-tier master's, master's, doctoral and non-degree study at 30+ Hungarian host universities.
amount: Full tuition, monthly stipend (HUF 43,700 non-degree / higher for doctoral), accommodation contribution, health insurance

title: Hungarian Diaspora Scholarship
description: Scholarship for members of the Hungarian diaspora living outside Europe to pursue full or partial degree study at a Hungarian higher education institution and strengthen ties with Hungary.
amount: Full tuition, monthly stipend, accommodation contribution and health insurance

title: Scholarship Programme for Christian Young People (SCYP)
provider: Tempus Public Foundation and the Hungary Helps Programme
description: Scholarship for young people from Christian communities facing persecution or hardship to pursue bachelor's, master's or doctoral study in Hungary, with a commitment to return home and support their community.
amount: Full tuition, monthly stipend, accommodation contribution and health insurance

title: Semmelweis University International Merit Scholarship
description: Tuition-reduction scholarships for high-performing fee-paying international students in the English-language health science programmes at Semmelweis University in Budapest.
amount: Partial tuition fee reduction based on academic performance

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (Hungary-hosted programmes)
description: Fully funded, integrated master's programmes run by a consortium of universities across at least three countries, several coordinated by or including Hungarian institutions. Students apply to the individual programme consortium.
amount: EUR 1,400 per month, full tuition, insurance and travel/installation allowances

deadlines.term: 2027 intake (deadline varies by programme, Oct 2026 - Jan 2027)
